utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? Folks are saying Saturday morning at the community shed, and it sounds like there should be a good turnout. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any last-minute changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — Saturday morning at the community shed is what I’ll pencil in for now. Please do keep an ear out for changes, and I’ll let Gus and the others know once it’s firm.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You’ve got it, Mara — I’ll keep my ears open and pass along anything I hear from Marla or the organizers before folks treat it as final.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Jules, I’m in for the repair drive—I just need the time and what we’re fixing, the quick version.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Bo — Saturday at 10 a.m.; Mara’s gathering the repair requests, and I’m matching tool needs with lenders and handoffs. If you tell me what tools or skills you can bring, I’ll plug you in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday at 10, got it—thanks. I can bring a basic tool kit and handle small furniture fixes or simple tightening jobs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Kira, I heard the repair drive is still shortest on screwdrivers, packing tape, and a few people to carry boxes or sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay — can you confirm that’s still the list and when they need it by? I just want to make sure I’ve got the details right.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll double-check while I’m out and let you know; last I heard it was screwdrivers, packing tape, and extra hands for carrying boxes and sorting donations.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, I’ve got the repair drive penciled in for Saturday at 10 a.m., but I’m checking the school calendar before I tell the other parents. Does that timing still work on your end?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, Saturday at 10 a.m. works for me. Just let me know once the school calendar is clear.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — I’ll confirm the school calendar and then let the other parents know it’s set for Saturday at 10 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Pia — I’m set to help with the repair drive Saturday at 10. If you need me to sort tools or track what still needs fixing, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — Saturday at 10 helps a lot. Could you handle tracking what still needs fixing, and do you know how long the drive is expected to run?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ll handle the repair list and bring my notepad. I’m not sure how long it’s expected to run yet, but I can check with Leo when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Vik — I’m pretty sure the repair drive is Saturday at 10, but I may be mixing up the details again. If you remember what still needs fixing, could you remind me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, we’re still on for Saturday morning at 10 for the repair drive. I’ll keep reminding everyone, and I think we’ll sort the remaining fixes once we’re all there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. If you remember the exact fixes before then, please keep me posted so I don’t muddle it up again.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m just catching up on the repair drive — I heard we’re still aiming for Saturday morning, but I’m holding off on hammer and screws until Mara confirms the exact list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good call, Dane — I’m waiting on the final list too. I’ll check the notice board and ask around, then we’ll have a clear plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I appreciate it. I’ll stay on standby and catch up once you’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Nell — I’m ready to bring the drill, screwdrivers, and duct tape, just let me know what time works best.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: 10 a.m. Saturday works great, Gus — if you can bring those tools, I’d love your help at the community room with check-in and labeling.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Nell — I’ll be at the community room at 10 a.m. Saturday with the drill, screwdrivers, and duct tape, and I’m happy to help with check-in and labeling.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have the repair drive details confirmed yet, so can you remind me what needs fixing and when it’s happening? I’d rather check than guess.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it’s still Saturday morning, and they mostly need tools plus a few hands sorting donations. I might be behind on any newer details, though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll treat Saturday morning, tools, and donation sorting as tentative for now, but I’m going to wait for Mara to confirm before I tell everyone what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still checking the shed for a hammer, screws, tape, and gloves. What else are you short on for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Cleo — we’re mostly short on extra tables, chairs, and maybe a couple power strips. If you can find any of those, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the shed for extra tables, chairs, and power strips, Quinn, and I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Opal — I’ve got duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves set aside, and I’ll drop them off before the repair drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — I’m marking duct tape and two pairs of gloves from you. Could you drop them by the community shed, and I’ll confirm the exact start time once I’ve verified it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure thing — I’ll drop them by the community shed. Just let me know the exact start time when you’ve confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa, I can come by briefly Saturday morning and sort a few supplies for the repair drive, if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — small update: the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so if you can spare a little time then, sorting supplies would still be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, Sunday at the community center should work—I can come by briefly and sort a few supplies then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Mara, I’m glad to help with the repair drive, but do we have a firm start and end time yet, and a list of supplies we’re still missing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Not quite yet — I’m still confirming the start and end times, and I’m keeping the missing supplies list updated. I’ll share both as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mara — please let me know as soon as you have the times and missing supplies. That’ll help me plan without any last-minute scrambling.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Vik — I’m planning to bring duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves before the repair drive starts, but I’m still waiting on the exact time window.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rey — duct tape and gloves will be handy. Rosa’s sending the final details today, and I’ll remind you as soon as we’ve got the exact Saturday morning time window.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — I’ll watch for Rosa’s update and get the duct tape and gloves there as soon as I know the time window.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still waiting on Mara to confirm the exact date and repair list, Jules, so I don’t want to send anyone off with guesses yet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Totally fair, Hana — let’s wait for Mara’s confirmation before I send anyone anywhere. Once she sends the date and list, I’ll help line up the tools and lenders.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’ll wait for Mara’s confirmation and then share the exact date and list so we can line up the tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, folks around here are saying Saturday morning by the shed, and it should be busiest right after drop-off. I’d still check with the organizers to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—Saturday morning by the shed sounds close enough for now, but I’ll wait for Rosa or Hana to confirm the exact time and list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s the safest bet, Bo — Rosa or Hana will have the real final word. I’ll keep my ear out and pass along anything solid I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus—bring the drill, screwdrivers, and duct tape first. Do you have any spare screws or hinges you can toss in too?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina—I’ve got a jar of assorted screws and I’ll check the garage for spare hinges to bring along too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, that’ll help a lot. If you find any extra tape or small hardware, bring those too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — quick update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’m pulling together the final helper list now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note Sunday at the community center and update the meetup location. Thanks for keeping the helper list moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Opal — that helps a lot. I’ll send the final helper assignments once I’ve heard back from the last few folks.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can stop by briefly Saturday morning to sort supplies, then I’ll need to head out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that works — thanks for helping with the supplies Saturday morning. We'll make use of the time you have.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’ll do what I can and keep it brief Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Ira, I’m spreading the word fast for the repair drive—if you know anyone handy or just willing to help out, send them my way and I’ll get them plugged in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll keep asking around while I’m out running errands and send anyone handy your way. Last I heard, they still really need screwdrivers, packing tape, and folks who can help carry boxes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Ira—please tell folks screwdrivers, packing tape, and box-carrying hands are especially needed. Send anyone interested straight to me and I’ll point them where to go.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sam, I think the repair drive is Saturday at 10 by the community shed — mainly that loose fence panel and the stubborn porch light. If I’ve got any of that wrong, please nudge me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You’ve got it right, Oren — Saturday at 10 by the community shed. I’m bringing a notepad too, so we can track anything else that needs fixing while we work.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, thank you, Sam — that notepad will save me from mixing things up again. I’ll tell folks Saturday at 10 by the shed, and we’ll start with the fence panel and porch light.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still checking the shed for a hammer, screws, tape, and gloves. What else are you short on for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s a great start—if you can also bring any extra tape or gloves, and help with volunteer check-in around 10, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can do that — I’ll check for extra tape and gloves, and I can help with volunteer check-in around 10.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Leo, before I spread the word, can you confirm whether it’s really 10 on Saturday and what supplies you’re expecting people to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — 10 on Saturday works. We mainly need screwdrivers, packing tape, and a few people to carry boxes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so I can tell people 10 on Saturday, and ask them to bring screwdrivers, packing tape, or be ready to carry boxes, right?
